However, strong operating margins of 47.6% and adequate liquidity (current ratio of 1.55) provide some offsetting support. Based on the high leverage and Altman Z-score of approximately 1.05 (indicating distress risk), the rating falls into speculative grade, specifically B+, reflecting high credit risk but some capacity for debt service given profitability.

DECISION: B+
